[[Lion]]s are [[charmable animal]]s found in several places on mainland [[Elona]].

==Locations==
*[[Core]]
**[[The Battle Isles]]
***{{NPC location|Zaishen Menagerie Grounds}} (levels 5, 12, 15, and 20, depending on unlock progress)
*[[Nightfall]]
**[[Kourna]]
***{{NPC location|Barbarous Shore}} (in the southeast corner)
***{{NPC location|Jahai Bluffs}} (level 12 [[aggressive]]; northwest from [[Command Post]], prior to completing [[The Great Zehtuka (quest)|the Great Zehtuka]])
**[[Vabbi]]
***{{NPC location|Forum Highlands}}
***{{NPC location|Holdings of Chokhin}}
***{{NPC location|Resplendent Makuun}}
***{{NPC location|Vehjin Mines}} (just outside [[Basalt Grotto]])
***{{NPC location|Wilderness of Bahdza}}
***{{NPC location|Yatendi Canyons}}
***{{NPC location|Vehjin Mines}}  (Right outside [[Jennur's Horde]])

==Notes==
*Lions deal [[slashing damage]].
*The group of Lions and Lionesses that normally appears in Vehjin Mines just outside Basalt Grotto fails to appear (most probably) if the quest [[Coffer of Joko]] is active ''and'' [[Master of Whispers]] is in the party.  The exact conditions are [[Talk:Nehpek the Remorseless#Disputed|disputed]].
*[[Zaishen_Menagerie_Grounds/Service_costs|Unlocking cost]]: 1{{zsilver}} plus 100{{gold}} or 1,000 [[Balthazar Faction]] ''(Common, Elona)''
{{anomaly|There is a group of [[aggressive]], but charmable, level 12 lions and [[lioness]]es northwest of the [[Command Post]] [[portal]] in [[Jahai Bluffs]]. This group is only available before you complete the quest [[The Great Zehtuka (quest)|the Great Zehtuka]].}}

==Trivia==
* In [[Guild Wars]], several lions and lionesses can be found together in a group; however, a pride of [[w:lion|real-world lions]] will only contain one or two males. Young male lions are ejected from the pride around the age of three, to live as nomads until they can form or overtake another pride.
